tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: Plans and pricing
tools.description: Northloop's current plans, prices and what each one includes.
tools.text:
Starter: $49 a month. Up to 5 active workflows and 2,000 runs a month, with email support.
Growth: $199 a month. Unlimited workflows, 25,000 runs a month, two-way HubSpot and Salesforce sync, and priority support.
Enterprise: custom pricing. SSO, an audit log, a 99.95% uptime SLA and a named success manager.
Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.

articles.title: Connect HubSpot
articles.text: The HubSpot integration syncs contacts, companies and deals both ways every 5 minutes. Setup takes about 10 minutes and needs a HubSpot Super Admin. It's available on the Growth and Enterprise plans.

articles.title: Workflow templates
articles.text: Start from 60 templates for lead routing, renewals, invoicing and support escalations, then edit any step.

articles.title: Security
articles.text: Northloop is SOC 2 Type II audited. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and hosted in the EU or the US.
